methodology: Long-format consolidation only. PLFS WPR percentages, PLFS worker industry shares, NCS vacancy counts, and NCS platform activity remain separate indicators. No PLFS-NCS subtraction or synthetic skill-gap target is created.

forecasting_readiness.monthly_plfs_wpr: Suitable for the existing short-horizon exploratory baseline forecast only; current history is short.
forecasting_readiness.plfs_industry_distribution: Three annual points; descriptive trend only, insufficient for a reliable ML forecast.
forecasting_readiness.ncs_sector_and_qualification_vacancies: Two annual observations; descriptive comparison only, insufficient for ML forecasting.
forecasting_readiness.genuine_skill_gap: Not model-ready until occupation/skill-level labour supply and demand are available in compatible units and periods.
